instruction: I need better contrast for italic text. Please make all italicized words both bold AND increase their font size from 12 to 16.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making italic text bold and size 16. Verified document has 21 italic text runs at size 12pt (152400 twips). Evaluator checks both bold property and size 16 for all italic runs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both requirements: bold property AND font size 16 for all italic text
Postconfig correctly saves the DOCX file before evaluation
Logic correctly iterates through all paragraphs and runs to find italic text
Minor edge case concern: If font size is inherited from paragraph/style rather than explicitly set on run, run.font.size may be None, causing false negatives
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider handling inherited font sizes by checking paragraph.style or using run.font.size with a fallback mechanism
Could add logging to track when italic runs are found but don't meet criteria
